summary: Deploy preflight policy (operator-approved 2026-09-18): a service that declares execution_mode=paper AND broker_route=none is a printed warning, not a block; everything touching real money still blocks. Read the whole diff (deploy_preflight.py + tests only; the positions fence and the v2 sibling preflight are untouched). The single overview.status gate is replaced by its components: overview errors (missing/unreadable field also blocks), reconciliation total_findings, critical findings, pending intents, open positions, and per-service health now over EVERY service row plus the required names, using effective_status and observed_at_raw; a stale heartbeat blocks even for a paper observer; the exemption never applies to a required or target service; no name allowlist. 21 tests pass with PYTHONPATH on the PR tree. Mutations RED, each edit confirmed applied: broker_route ignored, execution_mode ignored, exemption extended to required services, total_findings not blocking, overview errors not blocking, unreadable errors not blocking, stale paper observer not blocking. I ran the PR's evaluate function on the box's LIVE /api/overview (2026-09-19 08:05 ET): PASS with 0 warnings - the real JSON has an 'errors' list, so the new unreadable-errors rule cannot dead-lock the gate. On the same JSON with yesterday's 16:32 shape added (momentum-paper degraded, paper/none, feed_policy_violation): PASS with 1 warning; with broker_route=webull: BLOCK; schwab-1m-v2 degraded: BLOCK; oms-risk degraded: BLOCK; paper observer 600 s stale: BLOCK; reconciliation total_findings=1: BLOCK. Observation: on a weekend momentum-paper publishes no heartbeat, the overview is healthy and the OLD preflight also passes on the live JSON today - this PR is needed for weekday-evening deploys, not for today's.
